messages:
Priya: Quick heads-up — SOC2 runway triage. Fieldwork week w/c 2026-04-06; we need confirmation on KMS/HSM smoke results, auditlog backfill, and who's owning ticket handoff. Owners I've got: Priya (control mapping), Devon (KMS), Maya (auditlog). If your name not right, correct now.
Devon: I can own KMS prod smoke. ETA for final attestation docs is EOD Tue. Running a quick key rotation smoke tomorrow. @Maya do you need logs in a specific format? :white_check_mark:
Maya: Need JSON-lines logs with session id, key_id, action. Sample schema: ```{"ts":"...","session":"...","key_id":"k-123","action":"create"}``` I'll wire a small parser. Can anyone drop sample 1k lines test file?
Ash: I can generate a test file from staging ingest. Will push to s3://redwood-compliance/temp/kms-smoke-1k.json by 10:30PT.
Priya: Awesome. Also need to clarify who does evidence owner handoff for control 7.2 — that's currently unassigned. @devon @maya any volunteers?
Devon: I can take 7.2 for KMS. I'll create a checklist PR and link to the evidence folder.
Maya: I'll pair for the initial review. Can we add the audit timeframe to the PR description? auditors want timezone-aware ranges.
SRE-bot: Deploy notice: compliance-ingest v2.4 deployed to staging at 2026-04-01T15:12Z
Priya: Thanks — once Ash confirms S3 file, Devon will run the smoke and we'll mark status as 'smoke-ready'. If any blockers for access or IAM, ping @security-admin. Also tagging @oncall for weekend coverage questions.
Ash: File uploaded: s3://redwood-compliance/temp/kms-smoke-1k.json. ACLs set to private, devon has read. Ran a quick checksum: sha256=abc123...
Devon: Pulling file now. Running smoke: ```python tools/kms_smoke.py --input s3://... --limit 1000``` Will post results in thread.
Devon: Smoke finished — 1000 events processed, 2 warnings (missing session on 14 events). Uploading results gist: https://gist.github.com/xyz
Maya: I'll take those 14 events and backfill session ids where possible. May need a quick chat with platform to see if session propagation can be fixed.
Priya: Next steps: (1) Devon opens PR with checklist + results link (2) Maya does backfill + notes (3) Ash temp storage cleanup after review. Goal: mark KMS evidence as 'ready-for-fieldwork' by 2026-04-03 EOD. Sound good? :thumbsup:
Ash: Sounds good.
Devon: On it.
Maya: Ack. I'll start now and ping if I need infra help.
Priya: Thanks all. If nothing else, I'll fold this into the weekly compliance update doc.
thread_summary: Coordination thread for SOC2 runway: KMS/HSM smoke, audit log format, evidence ownership, and next steps to be ready for fieldwork.
